definitions.explanation: The old name of the western half of present-day Kagoshima Prefecture, and of the powerful domain ruled from there by the Shimazu family until 1871.

examples.japanese: ⟦{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}→西郷隆盛：31133_saigoutakamori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{薩摩|さつま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だ。
{薩摩|さつま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{長州|ちょうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。

{薩摩藩|さつまはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たし→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輩出|はいしゅつ}→輩出：14396_haishutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Satsuma domain played a central role in the Meiji Restoration and produced many statesmen.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The name lives on in many everyday words: ⟦さつまいも→さつまいも：10339_satsumaimo⟧ (sweet potato, which reached the rest of Japan by way of Satsuma), {薩摩揚|さつまあ}げ (fried fish cake), {薩摩焼|さつまやき} (Satsuma pottery) and the English "satsuma" orange. In history lessons it pairs with {長州|ちょうしゅう}, its ally against the shogunate: the {薩長同盟|さっちょうどうめい} of 1866.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薩摩藩|さつまはん}: the Satsuma domain
- {薩長|さっちょう}: Satsuma and Chōshū
- {薩摩|さつま}{弁|べん}: the Satsuma dialect, famous for being hard to follow
